lines.lyric_translation: If a second life that’s different from now is to come to me
Will I be by your side?

lines.lyric: Naneun neoye yeope isseulkka neoneun nae yeope isseulkka
lines.lyric_hangul: 나는 너의 옆에 있을까 너는 내 옆에 있을까
lines.lyric_translation: Will you be by my side?
I imagine things like this

lines.lyric: Seuchyeo ganeun nongdameuro kkeonaen bon marijiman
lines.lyric_hangul: 스쳐 가는 농담으로 꺼낸 본 말이지만
lines.lyric_translation: Even if they’re words I mentioned as a joke
Will you believe me?
Even if it’s a funny imagination
On a sudden day when I’m left alone

lines.lyric_hangul: 또 널 향해 발걸음을 떼어 (ooh hoo, ooh, hoo)
lines.lyric_translation: I’ll take my steps towards you again

lines.lyric: Neoye du nune nae eolgul boil ttae
lines.lyric_hangul: 너의 두 눈에 내 얼굴 보일 때
lines.lyric_translation: When I see my face in your two eyes
As if the world has stopped, I will hug you
If I am given a second life

lines.lyric: Amado jigeumgwaneun dareuge saragago sum shwigetjiman
lines.lyric_hangul: 아마도 지금과는 다르게 살아가고 숨 쉬겠지만
lines.lyric_translation: I may live and breathe differently compared to now

lines.lyric_hangul: 모른 채 지날 거리 속에 우린 서로를 기억하기를
lines.lyric_translation: Among the streets we’ll walk past each other without knowing / I hope we remember each other
Even in our next life / Even at that time, I’ll go to you
We’re already beautiful
I like it because it’s us
No words are necessary
The gaze, the touch
Even if a second life
That’s different from now comes to me

lines.lyric: Ttak han gaji malhal su itneun geon
lines.lyric_hangul: 딱 한 가지 말할 수 있는 건
lines.lyric_translation: The one thing I can say is

lines.lyric: Nan ne yeope isseul georan geot
lines.lyric_hangul: 난 네 옆에 있을 거란 것
lines.lyric_translation: That I’m going to be by your side
On a sudden day when I’m left alone

lines.lyric_hangul: 또 널 향해 발걸음을 떼어 (ooh hoo, ooh, hoo)
lines.lyric_translation: I’ll take my steps towards you again

lines.lyric: Neoye du nune nae eolgul boil ttae
lines.lyric_hangul: 너의 두 눈에 내 얼굴 보일 때
lines.lyric_translation: When I see my face in your two eyes
As if the world has stopped, I will hug you
If I am given a second life

lines.lyric: Amado jigeumgwaneun dareuge saragago sum shwigetjiman
lines.lyric_hangul: 아마도 지금과는 다르게 살아가고 숨 쉬겠지만
lines.lyric_translation: I may live and breathe differently compared to now

lines.lyric_hangul: 모른 채 지날 거리 속에 우린 서로를 기억하기를
lines.lyric_translation: Among the streets we’ll walk past each other without knowing / I hope we remember each other
Even in our next life / Even at that time, I’ll go to you
Being forgotten is common
Why are those common occurrences
Rather not easy for me?
Second life, second life
I know it can’t go my way
If I am given a second life

lines.lyric_hangul: 아마도 지금과는 다르게 살아가고 숨 쉬겠지만
